summary.text: Rebecca Bennett is the Democratic nominee for New Jersey's 7th Congressional District. A former U.S. Navy helicopter and experimental test pilot who later worked in healthcare, she is vice president of strategic partnerships and network operations at Oshi Health. She was previously a registered Republican and switched parties in July 2016, and is campaigning on affordability, healthcare, and national security.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, grew up in a small town; earned a high school diploma from the Texas Academy of Mathematics and Science.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell University, where she studied chemical engineering on an ROTC scholarship, before commissioning into the U.S. Navy.

Served more than 15 years in the Navy and Air National Guard as a helicopter pilot, experimental test pilot, and aircraft commander, flying the MH-60 Seahawk; according to her Ballotpedia survey, she became the 18th female U.S. Naval Test Pilot School graduate.
Earned an MBA from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School using the GI Bill while serving as a test pilot.

After leaving active duty, moved to New Jersey with her husband, also a Navy veteran, and worked in healthcare from early-stage startups to Fortune 50 companies; her campaign website says her work covered women's health, oncology, obesity, and gastrointestinal care.
Currently serves as vice president of strategic partnerships and network operations at Oshi Health.
Was previously a registered Republican and switched her registration to Democratic in July 2016.
Describes herself as a mother of two and says she volunteers to support veterans transitioning to civilian careers.
